Quick finance update: we can put the block + meeting room charges on the Redwood corporate Amex, but two caveats:

1) Amex sometimes flags merchants if MCC doesn't match expected categories for conference/hotel billing. Summit Hotels' connector triggered a hold this morning — I've attached the Amex notice they sent to us.
2) Any incidental charges (mini-bar, room service) should be handled by the individual guest's card unless pre-approved and added to a master folio. If we expect a lot of incidentals for execs, please confirm in advance and we'll review approvals.

If Amex releases the hold: we will charge the hotel and post the invoice to Redwood's ledger. If Amex keeps the hold, ops should either request Summit provide a direct invoice to Redwood or we temporarily pay the hotel and process reimbursements. Finance can expedite reimbursements within 48 hours for approved receipts and pre-cleared amounts — employees must submit digital receipts and the completed expense form.

Action items for Steph / Marcus: please ask Summit to provide a direct invoice option and a merchant contact. If they insist on card present, get the name on the folio and we will escalate to Amex to clear the hold.
